grid.layout_notes: Official 5×5. Boosted xBet disables bottom row in base (Wild Snek cannot enter disabled row).

win_system.notes: Base ways with xWays; bonus is snake-collect coin mode rather than classic lines.

other.name: Moving Wild Snek (base)
other.how_it_works: Lands anywhere; moves 1–5 steps any direction except backwards; path becomes Wilds. On revealed xWays → Wild of that Ways size.

other.name: Snek bonus movement
other.how_it_works: Sneks move until eat self or Slayer; wrap edges; multiple Sneks oldest-first; max 3 Sneks via Eggs; all dead ends round.

wilds.name: Moving Wild Snek
wilds.behavior: Base: path Wilds. Bonus: Snek heads collect coins/mults/eggs/slayers/collector/maxwin.

scatters.name: Scatter
scatters.behavior: 3 or 4 → Snek Spins (3rd/4th convert to Sneks). 5 → Super Snek Spins (3rd/4th → Sneks).

multipliers.name: Coin multiplier
multipliers.behavior: Values 1–5,10; eating mult increases coin mult applied to default coins.

collectors.name: Collector 2000
collectors.behavior: Sums visible coin values each spin start; if eaten, adds to counter then × win mult at eat time. Disappears after 4 uneaten steps; returns next spin.

specials.name: Coin
specials.behavior: Defaults 1–5,10,100 × bet; Snek eat adds to win.

specials.name: Egg
specials.behavior: New Snek from eater's tail; max 3 Sneks.

specials.name: Slayer
specials.behavior: Sticky; max 4; eating kills Snek for next spin.

specials.name: Upgrade (UP)
specials.behavior: Eating upgrades Snek Spins → Super Snek after round.

specials.name: xWays
specials.behavior: Reveal stacks; interact with Wild Snek path.

base_game_loop.summary: 5×5 ways with Moving Wild Snek (1–5 steps) and xWays. Boosted xBet +5% guarantees Scatter reel 2 and disables bottom row. 3–4 Scatter → Snek Spins; 5 → Super Snek Spins (snake-collect coins/mults/eggs until death). GOD MODE 1,689× / DELUXE 8,360×. Cap 8,110× then optional Double or Nothing to 16,220×.

phases.name: Configure Boosted xBet
phases.what_happens: Optional +5%: Scatter reel 2; bottom row disabled.

phases.name: Spin + Wild Snek
phases.what_happens: xWays reveal; Wild Snek moves 1–5 leaving Wilds; evaluate ways.

base_game_loop.win_evaluation: Base: ways with Wild path. Bonus: coin collects × mults; MAXWIN coin 8110×.
base_game_loop.notes: CMS; exact Snek Spins round length not a fixed FS count—ends when all Sneks die.

modes.name: Snek Spins
modes.spins_awarded: Snake-collect rounds until all Sneks die (not a fixed FS count on CMS).
modes.retrigger: Egg can spawn Sneks (max 3). UP symbol upgrades to Super after round.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: 3rd/4th Scatter → Sneks. Slayers sticky (max 4). Collector 2000 recurs.
modes.progressive_state: Coin mult from eaten multipliers; Collector sum.
modes.end_condition: All Sneks dead or Max Win / Double or Nothing.
modes.effects: Hold-style snake collect; convertible to Super via UP.

phases.name: Super Snek
phases.what_happens: Enhanced Snek Spins (CMS names mode; extra rules beyond convert scatters not detailed).

bonus_free_spins.notes: Fixed free-spin counts not printed; mode ends when Sneks die.

features.name: GOD MODE
features.effects: MAX on reel 1 + WIN on reel 5 same row → No Win or Max Win.

features.name: GOD MODE DELUXE
features.effects: Purchase Max Win into Double or Nothing.

options.name: GOD MODE DELUXE
options.effects: Buy Max Win → Double or Nothing.

feature_buy.notes: Generic Nolimit Bonus buy band not listed beyond GOD modes.

ante_bet.effects: Boosted xBet +5%: Scatter reel 2; bottom row disabled.

numeric_limits.max_win_notes: 8,110×; Double or Nothing can reach 16,220× or zero

evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Snek/Super Snek; Collector 2000; GOD MODE 1689/8360×; max 8110× + Double or Nothing.

unknowns: exact Super Snek mechanical deltas vs Snek Spins
